headline: Maui County Commission on Children & Youth

meeting.body: Maui County Commission on Children & Youth
meeting.summary: The commission chose five posters for buses and voted to have the vice chair write a letter of support to the Budget and Finance committee.
meeting.recap: The chair called the meeting to order on December 16 at 2:43 p.m.[[0:00:31]] The vice chair put her effort to promote commission meetings on social media on hold.[[0:05:27]] A deputy director said the commission has no budget of its own this fiscal year.[[0:11:50]] A commissioner said Maui Family Support Services can take in donations set aside for printing the posters.[[0:30:21]] A speaker cautioned commissioners against asking for donations for one particular organization.[[0:32:22]] The commission voted to have the vice chair write a letter of support to the Budget and Finance committee.[[1:00:34]] Commissioners volunteered to each review the mayor's past community meetings for one area and report back in January.[[1:14:37]] Maui County had 75 applications for Preschool Open Doors, which helps pay for 3- and 4-year-olds in licensed programs.[[1:19:24]] About half of those applications were denied.[[1:19:42]] The next meeting is January 27, 2025.[[1:22:47]]
decided: A motion to approve the November 18 minutes was made and seconded, but no vote is heard in the recording.
A motion to remove old business item one was made and seconded, but no vote is heard in the recording.
The commission authorized the vice chair to write a letter of support to Budget and Finance on its behalf.
meeting.next: The chair offered to write to the Maui County Council thanking it for passing the bill. The summary of the mayor's community budget meetings is to be an agenda item next time.

moments.q: Deputy director explains the county budget process
